flags.reason: misreads-source: The example passes `Padding: 'None'` in the modes of the inner `Text` children as well as the nested VStack. The guide only says "A nested group can use None when the surrounding section owns the inset", which is about the VStack owner. Nothing cited says Text takes a Padding mode or that children must repeat it.

The wording comes from the package declaration, so it is not flagged, but a human may want to check it so agents aren't misled. The examples use `Title` and `Badge`, which the evidence file's export list does not mention (it lists Button, HStack, VStack, Stack, Icon, Text and the action components).
